title: Image File Type Handling Error in Claude Analysis
body:
**Bug Description**
When examining a repo containing a jpg image, Claude tried to examine the jpg as if it were script or code file. This resulted in an API 

Error: Read(file_path: "small.jpg")…
  ⎿  Read image
  ⎿  API Error: 400 {"type":"error","error":{"type":"invalid_request_error","message":"messages.10.content.0.tool_result.content.0.image.source.base64.media_type: Input should be 'image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/gif' or 'image/webp'"}}

**Environment Info**
- Platform: linux
- Terminal: konsole
- Version: 0.2.35
- Feedback ID: cdd646b1-71f4-4298-b431-c84d38722240
